[SWS_DM_01255]
NRC
after failed service validation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04199
⌈
If a call to
ara::diag::ServiceValidation::Validate
returns any error code
except
kNoProcessingNoResponse
, the validation is be considered as failed and
a negative response code equal to the value of the error code according to
ara::
diag::DiagUdsNrcErrc
shall be sent as response.
⌋
